name: maine-farm-market
description: Maine Farm Market web, mobile, shared contracts, and Firebase backend.

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage "npm --prefix apps/web run test:rules"
scripts.test:e2e: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "npm --prefix services/functions run seed:emulator && npm --prefix apps/web run test:e2e"
scripts.mobile:bundle: npm run mobile:sync && cd apps/mobile/android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
